definitions.short: to take the right hand road
definitions.full: H541. aman [ אָמֵץ ] verb be stout, strong, bold, alert (according to Lag BN 28 f. from earlier אָמֹץ compare אֹמֶץ ) — Qal. Perfect 3 plural אָֽמְצוּ 2Sam 22:18 2 t.; Imperfect יֶאֱמָ֑ץ Gen 25:23 ; וַיֶּאֶמְצוּ 2Chr 13:18 ; Imperative אֱמַץ Josh 1:7 ; 1Chr 28:20 ; אֱמַ֑ץ Josh 1:6 ; אֱמָ֑ץ Deut 31:7 3 t.; אִמְצוּ 31:6 2 t. — 1 be strong , of a people Gen 25:23 (J); of personal enemies 2Sam 22:18 = Psa 18:18 ; 142:7 (all followed by מִן of comparison); also (without מן ) prevail 2Chr 13:18 . 2 Imperative be bold (always || חִזְקוּ חֲזַק, ), Deut 31:7 , 23 ; Josh 1:6-7 , 18 ; (|| id. + וְאַלתַּֿעַרְצוּ אַלתִּֿירְאוּ ) Deut 31:6 ; || id. + תֵּחָת וְאַל אַלתַּֿעֲרֹץ ) Josh 1:9 ; (|| id. + תֵּחָ֑תּוּ וְאַל תִּירְאוּ אַל ) 10:25 ; 1Chr 22:13 ; 28:20 ; 2Chr 32:7 . Pi`el Perfect אִמֵּץ Deut 2:30 etc.; Imperfect יְאַמֵּץ Amos 2:14 etc.; וַיְאַמֶּץלֿוֺ Isa 44:14 ; 3 feminine singular suffix 3 masculine singular תְּאַמְּצֶנּוּ Psa 89:22 ; 1 singular suffix אֲאַמִּצְכֶם Job 16:5 etc.; Imperative אַמֵּץ Nahum 2:2 ; אַמֵּ֑צוּ Isa 35:3 ; אַמְּצֵ֑הוּ Deut 3:28 ; Infinitive suffix אַמְּצוֺ Prov 8:28 ; Participle מְאַמֶּץֿ 24:5 ; 1 make firm, strengthen , followed by accusative, of giving clouds their place Prov 8:28 (subject ׳י ); of repairing temple 2Chr 24:13 ; of physical vigour Prov 31:17 ׃ זְרוֺעֶֹתיהָ וַתְּא מָתְנֶי֑הָ בְעוֺז ׳חָֽגְרָה (subject חַיִל אֵשֶׁת ); of strength for war ׳א כֹּחַ Nahum 2:2 (|| מָתְנַיִם חִזֵּק Amos 2:14 (subject חָזָק ); compare Prov 24:5 ; of royal power 2Chr 11:17 || חִזֵּק ; compare ׳א כּשְׁלוֺת בִּרְכַּיִם Isa 35:3 ; ׳א ׳בּ כֹּרְעוֺת Job 4:4 (both || רָפוֺת יָדַיִם חִזֵּק fig, of encouragement; so ׳א alone Deut 3:28 (|| חִזֵּק ) Job 16:5 (|| חשׂך q. v.); Psa 89:22 (subject י ׳זְרוֺעַ ); of support Isa 41:10 (subject ׳י ; || תמך עזר, ; — De Che below 2 ). 2 assure, secure for one's self, always followed by ל + suffix; of carpenter appropriating tree Isa 44:14 ; compare of ׳י appropriating Israel under figure of bough. Psa 80:16 ; under figure of chosen man 80:18 . 3 followed by לֵבָב harden, make obstinate Deut 2:30 (subject ׳י ; || רוּחוֺ הִקְשָׁה ) 15:7 (of unkind man); 2Chr 36:13 (of king Zedekiah, || אֶתעָֿדְמּוֺ הִקְשָׁה ). Hithpa`el Perfect הִתְאַמֵּץ 1Kin 12:18 2Chr 10:18 ; Imperfect וַיִּתְאַמְּצוּ 13:7 ; Participle מִתְאַמֶּצֶת Ruth 1:18 ; 1 strengthen oneself , of con-spirators 2Chr 13:7 (followed by עַל ). 2 confirm oneself in a, purpose, be determined Ruth 1:18 (followed by ל + Infinitive) 3 make oneself alert , make haste 1Kin 12:18 2Chr 10:18 (followed by ל + Infinitive) Hiph`il Imperfect Jussive exhibit strength, be strong ויא ׳חֲזַק לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְיַאֲמֵץ, Psa 27:14 , so also Psalm 31:25. ימן (√ of following; found in derivatives in all cognates, but original meaning dubious; Thes and others compare אמן confirm , whence right hand as the stronger ; others from use of right hand in confirming by an oath). II. [ יָמַן ] verb denominative Hiph`il go to or choose the right , use the right hand; — Imperfect 1singular coh. יְאֵימִ֫נָה Gen 13:10 (J) then I will go to the right (opposed to וְאַשְׂמְאִ֫ילָה ); 2 masculine plural תַּאֲמִינוּ Isa 30:21 , figurative of turning aside from right course of life (|| תַּשְׂמְאִילוּ ); Infinitive construct in phrase הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲדֹנִי דִּבֶּר אֲשֶׁר מִכֹּל וּלְהַשְׂמִיל לְהֵמִין אִםאִֿשׁ 2Sam 14:19 it is surely impossible to turn the right or to the left , etc.; Imperative feminine singular הֵימִ֫ינִי Ezek 21:21 go to the right! (opposed to הַשְׂמִ֫ילִי ); Participle plural use the right hand: בַּקָּ֑שֶׁת וּבַחִצִּים בָּאֲבָנִים וּמִשְׂמִאלִים מַיְמִינִים 1Chr 12:2 using the right hand and the left hand with stones and with arrows in the bow (i.e. in throwing and shooting).

occurrences.englishText: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”
